messages:
mika: quick heads-up — handing off a small weights source for onboarding. HF repo open/zeta-ml/zeta-13b published latest artifacts. target S3 path is s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/zeta13b/v1/weights/manifest.json. Need to verify access + checksum before we trigger mirror job. anyone able to check IAM delegation for ingest-role?

raj: I can look. do you have the expected checksum? also, is the manifest referencing shard names or a flat file?

mika: manifest references shards: zeta13b-00000.safetensors ...-00007.safetensors and a separate tokenizer.json. top-level manifest.sha256 = 9f2b3c6d1a2e4f789b0c123d4e5f6789c0b1a2d3e4f56789a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7

sophia: quick note — tokenizer.json includes a pad_token_id that differs from our tokenization service expectations (pad: 1 vs our default 0). that caused a small drift when running local decode smoke. pinged evals team.

jules: for perms: ingest-role currently only has s3:GetObject on the staging prefix. we need s3:ListBucket + GetObject on the prod prefix too. I can add ListBucket for the bucket, but someone from security needs to OK cross-account role assumption if HF -> registry flow uses external presigned links.

mika: thanks. raj, can you add the ListBucket and test with a dry-run mirror? example command i'll run after you patch: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/zeta13b/v1/weights/zeta13b-00000.safetensors /tmp/ && sha256sum /tmp/zeta13b-00000.safetensors```

raj: on it. FYI the registry currently blocks presigned URLs with TTL < 3600s; our artifact-sync job uses 300s by default. i'll bump the presign TTL to 24h for this run.

sophia: nice — also watch tokenizer padding in the serving config: set pad_token_id to 1 in the model config or run the tokenizer migration script. small example in casepack: `python tools/fix_tokenizer_padding.py --model zeta13b --pad 1`

mika: noted. one thing — manifest includes a companion .sha256 file per shard (e.g., zeta13b-00000.safetensors.sha256). ensure the mirror job validates both top-level manifest and per-shard checksums. if either mismatch, fail CANARY and notify #incidents.

ingest-bot: artifact-sync job queued: job_id=as-20260315-772, source=hf://open/zeta-ml/zeta-13b, target=s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/zeta13b/v1, mode=dry-run

jules: security approved cross-account presign for this publisher but only for the specific repo path and for 48h window. leaving a policy note on the registry PR.

raj: patched IAM and increased presign TTL. ran dry-run rsync with `--checksum` and got a single failed shard (00003) — downloaded .sha256 shows value d4c3b2a1b0c9e8f7d6c5b4a3a2b1c0d9e8f7c6b5a4d3c2b1a0f9e8d7c6b5a4c. file on HF has different sha. tagging @sophia to coordinate with source owner.

sophia: thanks — i'll open a quick PR to the HF repo asking them to reupload shard 00003. meanwhile, for serving readiness, set fallback to zeta13b-v0.9 in rollout so we can canary without user impact.

mika: perfect. i'll wait for a reupload and then re-run full mirror and checksum verification. once all green i'll kick off the onboarding pipeline and ping for code review on the model-config change. :thumbsup:

raj: re-run success after reupload, all checksums match. ingest-bot started full-sync job job_id=as-20260315-773.

ingest-bot: artifact-sync job started: job_id=as-20260315-773, status=running

mika: thanks everyone. follow-up tasks: - jules to add policy note in registry PR - sophia to confirm tokenizer migration script passes unit tests - raj to add a short CI step that validates per-shard .sha256 presence before mirror. will ping for CR once those are in.

jules: added policy note. leaving a comment on the PR with the approved statement.

sophia: tokenizer migration tests passing locally, pushing CI change now.

raj: CI step added in artifact-sync job; example check: `test -f $SHARD_PATH.sha256 || exit 1` — pushed to branch weights-iam-fix.

mika: great. once ingest-bot reports job complete i'll move this model from staging->onboarded in the registry and create a dedicated rollout with canary=5%. will update in the console. thanks all!

ingest-bot: artifact-sync job completed: job_id=as-20260315-773, status=success, duration=00:12:34

mika: onboarding done. closing thread. :party_parrot:
